title: Jovial Tender Kenyan Farfalle Pasta
description: A pungent and tender one-pot Kenyan dish featuring farfalle pasta, cooked with binchotan-charcoal for a smoky flavor, and suitable for flexitarian diets. This recipe combines the richness of Kenyan spices with the simplicity of Italian farfalle.
instructions: Heat a large one-pot skillet over medium heat, adding the binchotan charcoal for smoking.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for an additional minute.
Add the farfalle pasta, Kenyan curry powder, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the pasta is tender, about 15 minutes.
Remove the binchotan charcoal and stir the pasta to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
